description.fallback: Despite not being able to see the spirits, the guards gape at the new, abnormally-high temperature of the room, caused by the flames of Magician's Red, unknown to them. Meanwhile, Jotaro's evil spirit can be seen fully for the first time and grabs Magician's Red by the neck. This causes an identical marking to appear on Avdol's own neck, implying that damage to someone's evil spirit reflects on its user.
